## 21. Ex gratia Pension/Family Pension to CPF Retirees  
[ Swamy's -  
FR & SR, Part - IV]  
Central Government employees in receipt of pay up to ~ 500 p.m. who had rendered not less than 20 years of continuous service and retired prior to 18th November, 1960 with Contributory Provident Fund benefits are eligible for the grant of ex gratia pension.
